findings.finding: U17 is a TCA9555, which has internal ~100k pull-ups on every P-port (as strong as 33k: IIL -100 uA). From power-on until firmware configures it, the 100k pull-downs (R40,R41,R43,R44,R45) only make a divider: 1.65 V typ, 2.48 V worst. findings.evidence: TI SCPS200E sect 5 (TCA9555 = TCA9535 + internal I/O pull-up), p16 schematic 100 kOhm, p6 IIL -100 uA; YXC YSO110TR p1 Tri-State thresholds; core.net PHY_RST: R45 100k to GND, U17 P05, Y2 pin1; ETH_CLK: Y2 via R60, U7 pin 25 IO0, Q5 C; JSCJ 2N7002 VGS(th) 1.0-2.5 V

findings.finding: Proposed core J1 swap GCT USB4085-GF-A (C7095263) is a through-hole (DIP) receptacle with 16 separate pins in two 0.85 mm staggered rows; it does not fit the current SMD USB-C-SMD_MC-311D footprint or the merged-pad symbol (A4-B9, A1-B12...).
findings.evidence: GCT USB4085 drawing rev B sheet 1-2: Dip Type PCB Top Mount, 16x 0.40 holes in 0.65 pads, slots 0.6x2.1/0.6x1.4 at 8.65

findings.finding: Ultra U19 is ordered as PLR237/T8BK (C17223620) but placed on an EasyEDA PLR237-T10BK footprint (C17427482). The T8 lead form needs two 1.70 mm locating-peg holes (5.60 mm apart, 2.61 mm forward of the 1.10 mm post holes) that the footprint lacks, so the part cannot seat.
